gemini.value: Notice DA-2026-36 merged La Mesa and Spring Valley effective August 14, 2026, with zero newly flagged shipments since the previous notice. This quarantine covers a generated zone of about 120.5 sq mi (official: 173.0 sq mi) affecting 338.5 acres of commercial agriculture including avocado, citrus, stone fruit, and tomatoes due to new detections in La Mesa. Current shipment processing shows 10 needs review, 3 unclear (human check), 5 no flag (not a host), and 7 no flag (outside zone), with 16 out of 17 citations verified.
